name: Tiko
official_context: A scorpio bot whose motor creates up-and-down thread-based tail movement.
verified_facts: Tiko is a scorpio bot whose motor creates up-and-down thread-based tail movement.
Tiko uses a motor powered by a simple electrical circuit.
Tiko's tail movement relies on thread pulling and releasing mechanical action.
Troubleshooting Tiko involves checking battery connections, motor wire contact, and thread tension.

learning_materials.beginner: Tiko's motor pulls a thread to make its scorpio tail move up and down!
learning_materials.intermediate: When the circuit closes, electrical energy turns the motor axle. The attached thread gets pulled and released to create mechanical motion.
learning_materials.advanced: Troubleshooting thread-based mechanical systems requires examining friction, motor torque, electrical conductivity across battery contacts, and mechanical tension.
